hook: AI gave you a 400-word essay when you needed a yes or a no.
caption:
AI gave you a 400-word essay when you needed a yes or a no.

You asked: "Should I take this freelance project?"

Generic AI said: "There are many factors to consider when evaluating freelance opportunities. First, assess your current workload and bandwidth. Second, consider the financial implications. Third, weigh the potential for skill development..."

You closed the tab.

Here's the thing — the AI wasn't wrong. It just doesn't know that you're a bullet-point, bottom-line, give-it-to-me-straight thinker who makes fast decisions and hates being walked through things you already know.

So it defaulted to the response that offends nobody.

Which is also the response that helps nobody.

The fix isn't prompting harder. It's the AI actually knowing your thinking style before you say a word.

Some people WANT the 400 words. They want every angle covered before they decide. That response is perfect for them.

But not for you.

This is exactly why we built BootFile — a personalized AI profile that tells any AI how your brain works. So you stop getting the generic center-of-the-bell-curve answer and start getting the one that actually fits how you think.

One setup. Every conversation, calibrated.
